Inspired by the original BB680 – game-worn by the pros – we recreated a timeless classic with a simple and clean look.

Adjustable lace closure for a customized fit and leather upper for durability and a sporty look

How customer reviews and ratings work

Customer Reviews, including Product Star Ratings help customers to learn more about the product and decide whether it is the right product for them.

To calculate the overall star rating and percentage breakdown by star, we don’t use a simple average. Instead, our system considers things like how recent a review is and if the reviewer bought the item on Amazon. It also analyzed reviews to verify trustworthiness.

Amazon Customer
5 out of 5 stars
Perfect! Super comfortable and good quality! New Balance rocks!
I’m an Adidas girl, so these are my first pair of New Balance shoes. I only bought them because the price was unbeatable, and I could tell they would fit my style perfectly. They’re incredibly comfortable, provide great arch support, have plenty of traction for everyday wear, and are very well made. You can tell they’re made from high-quality materials, yet they’re not heavy at all. I feel so confident walking in them. They make me feel like I could step on almost anything without worrying, my feet feel protected, and the shoes feel sturdy and durable. My feet measure 24 cm (heel to toe), and I usually wear a US women’s size 7.5, sometimes an 8. Since these are men’s sizing, I ordered a men’s size 6, and they fit perfectly! They’re not too long or too tight, just the perfect fit. I’m extremely happy with this purchase and can’t recommend these shoes enough. I can definitely see myself buying more pairs of this model in the future!

    I really liked the look and overall quality of these New Balance 480 sneakers. They have a classic design that goes well with casual outfits, and the materials feel durable and well made.

    The shoes were comfortable right out of the box, with good support for everyday wear. The sole feels sturdy, and the overall construction seems high quality.

    The main thing I would mention to other buyers is that they ran a little larger than expected for me. I ordered my usual size, but I felt I would have been more comfortable going down one size. If you are between sizes, you may want to consider sizing down.

    Overall, these are great-looking sneakers with solid comfort and quality. I would definitely recommend them, especially if you pay close attention to sizing before ordering.
